panels.scene_description: Kessa walks slowly toward the Mill, her boots sinking into the wet grass along the riverbank.
The serene riverbank, devoid of any human presence, reflects the calm and undisturbed beauty of nature.
The old waterwheel's ancient machinery hummed in the dimly lit workshop, its gears and drums creaking as it continued to spin, its moss-covered wooden spokes whispering secrets of time.
The scene unfolds in a dimly lit room, with a lone figure pushing open a dusty door, her steps echoing against the cold stone walls.
The quiet, familiar setting of the Mill is transformed as Kessa returns, her long, flowing black hair cascading down her back in a gentle cascade, adding a touch of elegance to the scene.
She stands at the water's edge, watching the wheel turn in the fading light, her eyes reflecting memories of what has transpired there.
